mr-nobody-against-putin.why: The site tags it 2024 and 2025; it is the 2025 Short List's film (Cinema Eye, Oscars 2025).

the-great-hack.why: No year tag; the 2019 Short List post names it (a second page, the-great-hack-2, is tagged 2019: the same IMDb film, listed once).

2014 red-army.why: The site misspells the director (GABE POLKSY); IMDb's Red Army (2014) is by Gabe Polsky.

2017 chasing-coral.why: IMDb credits the director as Jeff Orlowski-Yang, the site as Jeff Orlowski.

2018 free-solo.why: Two titles fit; tt9271172 is the video Free Solo 360, a companion piece.

2020 the-social-dilemma.why: IMDb credits the director as Jeff Orlowski-Yang, the site as Jeff Orlowski.

2021 summer-of-soul.why: The site names the director Ahmir Thompson, IMDb credits Questlove.

2021 julia.why: Two titles fit because the same directors made My Name Is Pauli Murray (tt11092594); the film is Julia.

2021 attica.why: The site's director line is Stanley Nelson plus a Co-Director label that the page reader doesn't split off; IMDb's Attica (2021) is by Stanley Nelson and Traci Curry.
